description: Managed device driver for the Netvio 4x4 Video Matrix.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Netvio header, stock Cognio controls, routing laid out as aligned grids.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect, Disconnect and Autoconnect buttons: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only after the matrix accepts the login, and a matrix that stops answering is dropped and retried.
